title: Blog post disputes claim that Astra weight editing improves Qwen
summary: A Hacker News–discussed blog post contends that claims about Astra reading and writing model weights to improve Qwen are misleading, arguing that the demonstrated effect is narrower than the framing implies. The critique&\#x27;s central point, as summarized in the discussion, is that the key result reduces reasoning loops—cases where the model assigns too little probability to the token that ends its reasoning—rather than making Qwen better at math. Commenters working in mechanistic interpretability say such loops can be addressed with simple steering vectors, while others note that the original post already described some of these limits and that the techniques resemble prior published work.
